label: Custom / manual
notes: No auto-fill. Set Direct API format and Direct API URL yourself.

label: Ollama
notes: Exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions shim over its native API. No /v1/responses support.

label: llama.cpp server
notes: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions. No /v1/responses and no documented model-unload endpoint.

label: vLLM
notes: Newer vLLM releases also expose /v1/responses, but /v1/chat/completions is kept as the safer default here since Responses support varies by version.

label: Unsloth Studio
notes: Also exposes /v1/responses and an Anthropic-style /v1/messages endpoint (that format isn't implemented by this pack yet). Requires an Authorization: Bearer API key on every call. No fixed default port confirmed, so its URL isn't auto-filled -- check your own Unsloth Studio configuration.
